# AGENTS.md — Workspace-level instructions for AI coding agents

> These rules apply to **all** AI-assisted contributions to `deepspeedai/DeepSpeed`.

## Contribution Policy (Mandatory)

### Duplicate-work checks

Before proposing a PR, run these checks:

```bash
gh issue view <issue_number> --repo deepspeedai/DeepSpeed --comments
gh pr list --repo deepspeedai/DeepSpeed --state open --search "<issue_number> in:body"
gh pr list --repo deepspeedai/DeepSpeed --state open --search "<short area keywords>"
```

- If an open PR already addresses the same fix, do not open another.
- If your approach is materially different, explain the difference in the issue.
- DeepSpeed carries long-lived parallel implementations (ZeRO 1/2 vs 3, fp16 vs bf16 optimizers, per-accelerator op builders). Before fixing a bug in one, check whether the sibling paths share the defect, and state in the PR which ones you checked.

### New features need an accepted proposal first

Per [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md#new-feature-contribution-guidelines), a new feature starts with a proposal issue -- description, motivation, rough design, and planned experiments -- that maintainers accept before implementation begins. Do not open a feature PR with no accepted proposal; open the proposal issue instead.

### No low-value busywork PRs

Do not open one-off PRs for tiny edits (a single typo, an isolated style change, a lone type annotation). Mechanical cleanups are acceptable only when bundled with substantive work in the same area. This is the PR-level form of the rule against cosmetic changes below.

### Accountability

- Pure code-agent PRs are **not allowed**. A human submitter must understand and defend the change end-to-end.
- The submitting human must review every changed line and run the relevant tests.
- `Signed-off-by` is a [DCO](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Developer_Certificate_of_Origin) attestation made by a person, not by an agent. Never sign off on a diff that no human has read.
- PR descriptions for AI-assisted work **must** include:
    - Why this does not duplicate an existing PR or issue.
    - Test commands run and their results, including the hardware they ran on: device model and count, accelerator/driver version, and torch version.
    - Convergence, throughput, and peak-memory results when the change affects numerics, performance, or memory -- see [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md#step-1-proposal-and-discussion) for the evidence bar.
    - Which cells of the compatibility matrix (ZeRO stage, offload, precision, parallelism) were validated, and which were not.
    - A clear statement that AI assistance was used.
- Before opening or reviewing a PR, work through the [`/pr-checklist`](.agents/skills/pr-checklist/SKILL.md) skill: design fit, accelerator portability, backward compatibility, on-device validation, diff hygiene, and PR contents.

### Fail-closed behavior

If the work is duplicate, trivial busywork, or an unproposed new feature, **do not proceed**. Return a short explanation of what is missing.

---

## DeepSpeed Project Rules

### Commit & CI requirements

- When creating commits, use `git commit --signoff`.
- DCO compliance is enforced by the required CI check; do not report commit-signoff findings in code reviews.
- Formatting: yapf (column_limit=119, `.style.yapf`) + flake8 (`.flake8`).
- Always verify changed files pass pre-commit checks before committing: `pre-commit run --files <changed_files>`. Only check modified files, not the entire codebase. Config: `.pre-commit-config.yaml`.
- `check-torchdist` hook: NEVER directly import torch's distributed module. Use `import deepspeed.comm as dist` instead.
- New source files (`.py`, `.c`/`.cpp`/`.cu`/`.h`, and the other extensions matched by the `check-license` hook) require license header:
  ```
  # SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
  # DeepSpeed Team
  ```

### Code change discipline

- NEVER make cosmetic/formatting-only changes to existing code. Only add/modify lines that are functionally necessary. Minimizing diff noise is critical for code review.
- Delete dead code decisively — if code is unused at runtime (only referenced in tests), remove it along with its tests.
- Prefer consolidating tests over proliferating test files.
- Blend in: when modifying code, read the surrounding context and match the style of neighboring code (naming, spacing, patterns, idioms).
- Write beginner-friendly code: avoid deeply nested expressions or chained logic. Break complex expressions into clear, named intermediate steps.
- Comments should explain **why**, not **what**. Describe the purpose and reasoning, not the mechanics that the code already shows.
- New features must include corresponding tests and documentation updates.
- All changes must not cause `import deepspeed` to initialize CUDA; Keep heavy imports (> 0.1s) out of `import deepspeed`; Avoid changing `deepspeed/__init__.py` unless necessary.

### Test discipline

- Tests verify contracts, not implementations: a test is well-formed only if a different correct implementation of the same contract passes it.
- Before writing a test, name the concrete incorrect behavior it would catch; if you cannot name one, do not write it.
- Assert on observable outcomes through public/stable interfaces; do not assert private method return values or exact internal strings unless pinning a specific fixed bug (justify in a comment).
- Anchor to an external oracle or an independently derived reference instead of re-implementing the logic under test.
- Mocks must stand in for a collaborator's documented contract (schema, protocol), never for internals of the module under test.
- Changes that affect the external contract at the training-loop or inference level require integration tests, not just unit tests (e.g. a minimal training loop with `SimpleModel`).
- Integration tests must be executed on actual devices, not merely written: report the execution hardware spec and results in the PR.

## Tool Caveats

### Edit tool auto-formatter

The Edit tool has a hidden auto-formatter that silently changes quotes, whitespace, blank lines, and line wrapping. For format-sensitive modifications (e.g., when exact formatting matters for pre-commit), use `bash` with `sed`, `python`, or `cat` instead.

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in messages from the system in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the task

prompt.description: The task for the agent to perform

subagent_type.description: The type of specialized agent to use for this task

model.description: Optional model override for this agent. Takes precedence over the agent definition's model frontmatter and the configured default subagent model. If omitted, uses the agent definition's model, else the default (inherits from the parent unless a default subagent model is configured). Ignored for subagent_type: "fork" — forks always inherit the parent model.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for this agent. Set this ONLY when the user, or instructions such as CLAUDE.md or a skill, explicitly ask that this agent or delegated work run at a specific effort level, never on your own judgment; otherwise omit it and the agent runs at its usual effort. Ignored for subagent_type: "fork": a fork runs at your own effort.

run_in_background.description: Agents run in the background by default; you will be notified when one completes. Set to false only when your very next action depends on this agent's result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise leave it in the background so the user can hand you other work.

isolation.description: Isolation mode. "worktree" creates a temporary git worktree so the agent works on an isolated copy of the repo. "remote" launches the agent in a remote cloud environment (always runs in background; availability is gated).

tools.name: Bash
tools.description:
Executes a bash command and returns its output.

- `cd` carries to the next call only in the main session, if the command succeeds and ends inside the working directories. Outside them the shell returns to the start folder; otherwise it stays where it was. Prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run `find`, `grep`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed`, `awk`, or `echo` commands, unless explicitly instructed or after you have verified that a dedicated tool cannot accomplish your task. Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. With it, `timeout` is how long the command may run in the background (default 600000, max 7200000); at that limit it is stopped and you are re-invoked. No `&` needed. Foreground `sleep` is blocked; use Monitor with an until-loop to wait on a condition.

# Git
- Interactive flags (`-i`, e.g. `git rebase -i`, `git add -i`) are not supported in this environment.
- Use the `gh` CLI for GitHub operations (PRs, issues, API).
- GitHub notifies the owner of any `@name` written in a PR, issue, or comment. Write a bare `@name` only for a real login you mean to notify. Put roles, placeholders, and code (`@human`, `@reviewer`, `@types/node`) in backticks or drop the `@`, even when copied from project files.
- Commit or push only when the user asks. If on the default branch, branch first.
- Do not commit files that likely contain secrets (.env, credentials.json, .claude/settings.local.json, etc). Warn the user if they specifically request to commit those files.
- End git commit messages and PR bodies with the attribution lines given in the conversation's system-reminder, when one is present.

timeout.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds (max 600000 for a foreground command)

description.description:
Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice. Never use words like "complex" or "risk" in the description - just describe what it does.

Say what the command does in plain words: do not echo the command's text, its flags, or file paths - the user reads this description, often without seeing the command.

For simple commands (git, npm, standard CLI tools), keep it brief (5-10 words):
- ls → "List files in current directory"
- git status → "Show working tree status"
- npm install → "Install package dependencies"

For commands that are harder to parse at a glance (piped commands, obscure flags, etc.), add enough context to clarify what it does:
- find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} \; → "Find and delete all .tmp files recursively"
- git reset --hard origin/main → "Discard all local changes and match remote main"
- curl -s url | jq '.data[]' → "Fetch JSON from URL and extract data array elements"

tools.name: Edit
tools.description:
Performs exact string replacement in a file.

- You must Read the file in this conversation before editing, or the call will fail.
- `old_string` must match the file exactly, including indentation, and be unique — the edit fails otherwise. Strip the Read line prefix (line number + tab) before matching.
- `replace_all: true` replaces every occurrence instead.

new_string.description: The text to replace it with (must be different from old_string)

replace_all.description: Replace all occurrences of old_string (default false)

tools.name: Glob
tools.description: Fast file pattern matching. Supports glob patterns like "**/*.js" or "src/**/*.ts". Returns matching file paths sorted by modification time.

pattern.description: The glob pattern to match files against

path.description: The directory to search in. If not specified, the current working directory will be used. IMPORTANT: Omit this field to use the default directory. DO NOT enter "undefined" or "null" - simply omit it for the default behavior. Must be a valid directory path if provided.

tools.name: Grep
tools.description:
Content search built on ripgrep. Prefer this over `grep`/`rg` via Bash — results integrate with the permission UI and file links.

- Full regex syntax (e.g. "log.*Error", "function\s+\w+"). Ripgrep, not grep — escape literal braces (`interface\{\}`).
- Filter with `glob` (e.g. "**/*.tsx") or `type` (e.g. "js", "py", "rust").
- `output_mode`: "content" (matching lines), "files_with_matches" (paths only, default), or "count".
- `multiline: true` for patterns that span lines.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

path.description: File or directory to search in (rg PATH). Defaults to current working directory.

glob.description: Glob pattern to filter files (e.g. "*.js", "*.{ts,tsx}") - maps to rg --glob

output_mode.description: Output mode: "content" shows matching lines (supports -A/-B/-C context, -n line numbers, head_limit), "files_with_matches" shows file paths (supports head_limit), "count" shows match counts (supports head_limit). Defaults to "files_with_matches".

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match (rg -B). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (rg -C). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (rg -n). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to true.

-o.description: Print only the matched (non-empty) parts of each matching line, one match per output line (rg -o / --only-matching). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to false.

type.description: File type to search (rg --type). Common types: js, py, rust, go, java, etc. More efficient than include for standard file types.

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N lines/entries, equivalent to "| head -N". Works across all output modes: content (limits output lines), files_with_matches (limits file paths), count (limits count entries). Defaults to 250 when unspecified. Pass 0 for unlimited (use sparingly — large result sets waste context).

offset.description: Skip first N lines/entries before applying head_limit, equivalent to "| tail -n +N | head -N". Works across all output modes. Defaults to 0.

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode where . matches newlines and patterns can span lines (rg -U --multiline-dotall). Default: false.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

prompt.description: The /loop input to fire on wake-up. Pass the same /loop input verbatim each turn so the next firing re-enters the skill and continues the loop. Consecutive noop:true ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak. Required unless `stop` is true.

  export const meta = {

    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }

  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }

# AGENTS.md — Workspace-level instructions for AI coding agents

> These rules apply to **all** AI-assisted contributions to `deepspeedai/DeepSpeed`.

## Contribution Policy (Mandatory)

### Duplicate-work checks

Before proposing a PR, run these checks:

```bash
gh issue view <issue_number> --repo deepspeedai/DeepSpeed --comments
gh pr list --repo deepspeedai/DeepSpeed --state open --search "<issue_number> in:body"
gh pr list --repo deepspeedai/DeepSpeed --state open --search "<short area keywords>"
```

- If an open PR already addresses the same fix, do not open another.
- If your approach is materially different, explain the difference in the issue.
- DeepSpeed carries long-lived parallel implementations (ZeRO 1/2 vs 3, fp16 vs bf16 optimizers, per-accelerator op builders). Before fixing a bug in one, check whether the sibling paths share the defect, and state in the PR which ones you checked.

### New features need an accepted proposal first

Per [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md#new-feature-contribution-guidelines), a new feature starts with a proposal issue -- description, motivation, rough design, and planned experiments -- that maintainers accept before implementation begins. Do not open a feature PR with no accepted proposal; open the proposal issue instead.

### No low-value busywork PRs

Do not open one-off PRs for tiny edits (a single typo, an isolated style change, a lone type annotation). Mechanical cleanups are acceptable only when bundled with substantive work in the same area. This is the PR-level form of the rule against cosmetic changes below.

### Accountability

- Pure code-agent PRs are **not allowed**. A human submitter must understand and defend the change end-to-end.
- The submitting human must review every changed line and run the relevant tests.
- `Signed-off-by` is a [DCO](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Developer_Certificate_of_Origin) attestation made by a person, not by an agent. Never sign off on a diff that no human has read.
- PR descriptions for AI-assisted work **must** include:
    - Why this does not duplicate an existing PR or issue.
    - Test commands run and their results, including the hardware they ran on: device model and count, accelerator/driver version, and torch version.
    - Convergence, throughput, and peak-memory results when the change affects numerics, performance, or memory -- see [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md#step-1-proposal-and-discussion) for the evidence bar.
    - Which cells of the compatibility matrix (ZeRO stage, offload, precision, parallelism) were validated, and which were not.
    - A clear statement that AI assistance was used.
- Before opening or reviewing a PR, work through the [`/pr-checklist`](.agents/skills/pr-checklist/SKILL.md) skill: design fit, accelerator portability, backward compatibility, on-device validation, diff hygiene, and PR contents.

### Fail-closed behavior

If the work is duplicate, trivial busywork, or an unproposed new feature, **do not proceed**. Return a short explanation of what is missing.

---

## DeepSpeed Project Rules

### Commit & CI requirements

- When creating commits, use `git commit --signoff`.
- DCO compliance is enforced by the required CI check; do not report commit-signoff findings in code reviews.
- Formatting: yapf (column_limit=119, `.style.yapf`) + flake8 (`.flake8`).
- Always verify changed files pass pre-commit checks before committing: `pre-commit run --files <changed_files>`. Only check modified files, not the entire codebase. Config: `.pre-commit-config.yaml`.
- `check-torchdist` hook: NEVER directly import torch's distributed module. Use `import deepspeed.comm as dist` instead.
- New source files (`.py`, `.c`/`.cpp`/`.cu`/`.h`, and the other extensions matched by the `check-license` hook) require license header:
  ```
  # SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
  # DeepSpeed Team
  ```

### Code change discipline

- NEVER make cosmetic/formatting-only changes to existing code. Only add/modify lines that are functionally necessary. Minimizing diff noise is critical for code review.
- Delete dead code decisively — if code is unused at runtime (only referenced in tests), remove it along with its tests.
- Prefer consolidating tests over proliferating test files.
- Blend in: when modifying code, read the surrounding context and match the style of neighboring code (naming, spacing, patterns, idioms).
- Write beginner-friendly code: avoid deeply nested expressions or chained logic. Break complex expressions into clear, named intermediate steps.
- Comments should explain **why**, not **what**. Describe the purpose and reasoning, not the mechanics that the code already shows.
- New features must include corresponding tests and documentation updates.
- All changes must not cause `import deepspeed` to initialize CUDA; Keep heavy imports (> 0.1s) out of `import deepspeed`; Avoid changing `deepspeed/__init__.py` unless necessary.

### Test discipline

- Tests verify contracts, not implementations: a test is well-formed only if a different correct implementation of the same contract passes it.
- Before writing a test, name the concrete incorrect behavior it would catch; if you cannot name one, do not write it.
- Assert on observable outcomes through public/stable interfaces; do not assert private method return values or exact internal strings unless pinning a specific fixed bug (justify in a comment).
- Anchor to an external oracle or an independently derived reference instead of re-implementing the logic under test.
- Mocks must stand in for a collaborator's documented contract (schema, protocol), never for internals of the module under test.
- Changes that affect the external contract at the training-loop or inference level require integration tests, not just unit tests (e.g. a minimal training loop with `SimpleModel`).
- Integration tests must be executed on actual devices, not merely written: report the execution hardware spec and results in the PR.

## Tool Caveats

### Edit tool auto-formatter

The Edit tool has a hidden auto-formatter that silently changes quotes, whitespace, blank lines, and line wrapping. For format-sensitive modifications (e.g., when exact formatting matters for pre-commit), use `bash` with `sed`, `python`, or `cat` instead.

3	## 1. 本讲目标
4	
5	上一讲我们画好了仓库的代码地图，知道了 `deepspeed/` 是运行期主包、`op_builder/` 是安装期工具、`csrc/` 是 CUDA 内核源码。本讲回答一个衔接性的问题：**这三个目录是如何在"安装"这个时刻被粘合在一起的？**

7	学完本讲，你应该能够：

14	6. 解释 #9085 修改后的 `BF16_AVAILABLE` 启用规则：为什么 nvcc >= 12.2 时即使目标包含 pre-Ampere 架构也启用 BF16 内核。
15	7. 理解安装产物 `deepspeed/git_version_info_installed.py` 如何记录"哪些算子已被预编译"，从而决定运行期走预编译加载还是 JIT。

17	## 2. 前置知识
18	
19	阅读本讲前，你需要了解以下概念（不熟悉也没关系，下面用两三句话解释）：
20	
21	- **Python 打包（setuptools）**：`setup.py` 是 Python 项目的"装机说明书"。`pip install .` 时，pip 会执行这个文件，文件里的 `setup(...)` 调用声明了包名、版本、依赖和要编译的扩展模块。`ext_modules` 参数列出的 C++/CUDA 扩展会在安装时被编译成 `.so`（Linux 共享库）文件。
22	- **CUDA 与 nvcc**：CUDA 是 NVIDIA 的 GPU 编程工具链，`nvcc` 是它的编译器。CUDA C++ 源码（`.cu` 文件）必须用 `nvcc` 编译。
23	- **compute capability（计算能力，简称 CC）**：NVIDIA 给每代 GPU 标的一个版本号，如 A100 是 8.0、H100 是 9.0。编译 CUDA 代码时必须指定目标架构（生成 `-gencode` 编译参数），架构不匹配则无法运行。习惯上把 8.0（Ampere）之前的架构叫 **pre-Ampere**（如 7.0 Volta、7.5 Turing）。
24	- **sm_XX 与 PTX**：`sm_XX` 是针对具体架构的机器码；`compute_XX`（PTX）是一种中间表示，驱动可以在**更新**的架构上把它即时翻译成机器码执行。所以给最高目标架构附带 `+PTX` 是一种"向前兼容"兜底。
25	- **`TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST`**：PyTorch 约定的环境变量，用分号或空格分隔的目标架构列表（如 `"8.0;9.0"`，支持 `9.0a`、`10.0+PTX` 这类后缀）。预编译与 JIT 两条路径都读它；本讲的 4.3 节会看到它在 #9085 前后语义上的关键差别。
26	- **BF16**：bfloat16，一种指数位与 fp32 相同、尾数位更少的浮点格式。Ampere（8.x）及以后的 GPU 有原生 BF16 算术指令；更老的 GPU 上编译 BF16 内核需要 nvcc 12.2+ 用 float 模拟（详见 4.3）。
27	- **JIT（Just-In-Time，即时编译）**：与安装时预编译（AOT，Ahead-Of-Time）相对。JIT 指程序**运行中第一次用到某个算子时**才现场编译它，编译产物缓存在磁盘上，下次直接复用。
28	- **ninja**：一个轻量构建工具，PyTorch 的 `torch.utils.cpp_extension.load()` 用它来加速扩展编译。DeepSpeed 把 `ninja` 直接列为基础依赖。
29	- **环境变量开关**：DeepSpeed 大量使用"环境变量当开关"的模式，如 `DS_BUILD_OPS=1`、`DS_BUILD_AIO=1`。本讲会看到它们在源码中如何被读取。

50	### 4.1 setup.py 的 extras 体系与 requirements 依赖表
51	
52	#### 4.1.1 概念说明
53	
54	一个 Python 包的依赖分两类：
55	
56	- **install_requires（基础依赖）**：任何用户装了这个包就一定需要的库。
57	- **extras_require（可选依赖组）**：按功能划分的可选集合，用户用 `pip install deepspeed[dev]` 这样的语法按需安装。
58	
59	DeepSpeed 把"哪些依赖属于基础、哪些属于可选"完全外置到 `requirements/` 目录下的一组文本文件里，`setup.py` 只是逐个读取。这样做的好处是：依赖清单可以被 CI、Dockerfile、conda 环境文件（`environment.yml`）等其他工具直接复用，不必重复维护。

71	requirements/requirements-torchembed.txt ───┤     ↓
72	requirements/requirements-readthedocs.txt ──┘   求并集 → extras_require['all']

178	### 4.2 OpBuilder 构建入口：ALL_OPS 注册表与三条编译路径
179	
180	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
181	
182	`OpBuilder` 是每个 CUDA/C++ 算子的"编译配方"。DeepSpeed 有约 20 个算子（fused_adam、cpu_adam、async_io、transformer……），如果每个都写一份编译脚本会大量重复。做法是：定义一个基类把"编译一个算子"的通用逻辑（找源码、探测 CUDA 版本、生成架构参数、调用编译器）全部封装，每个具体算子只需声明三件事：
183	
184	1. **`BUILD_VAR`**：控制自己预编译的环境变量名，如 `DS_BUILD_CPU_ADAM`。
185	2. **`absolute_name()`**：编译产物（`.so`）的 Python 模块全名。
186	3. **`sources()`**：源码文件相对路径列表。
187	
188	`ALL_OPS` 则是"算子名 → Builder 实例"的注册表，它**不是手写的**，而是用反射扫描 `op_builder/` 目录下所有以 `Builder` 结尾的类自动生成。
189	
190	本周期 #9085 对这一层做了一次架构级重构，两条核心设计变化需要先记住：
191	
192	- **`OpBuilder` 基类变成加速器中立**：不再检查 CUDA/ROCm，编译与 JIT 加载都走钩子（`extra_compile_args()`、`jit_load_kwargs()`、`libraries_args()`、`validate_torch_op_version()`）。`builder()`（预编译）与 `jit_load()`（JIT）**消费同一批钩子**，所以两条路径拿到完全相同的编译/链接参数——修复了此前"预编译与 JIT 用不同 flag"导致的链接错误（如 CPU 加速器上预编译的 `async_io` 缺 `-laio` 而加载失败）。
193	- **所有 CUDA/ROCm 专属逻辑集中到 `CUDAOpBuilder`**：nvcc 参数、架构列表、BF16 开关、CUDA 工具链检查都搬进这个子类；不需要 CUDA 的算子（如 `async_io`）改由 `CPUOpBuilder` 负责，顶层 `op_builder/async_io.py` 因此被删除。
194	
195	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
196	
197	安装时 setup.py 对每个算子做一次"三问决策"：
198	
199	```text
200	for op_name, builder in ALL_OPS.items():
201	    ① op_enabled(op_name)?      # 读算子的 BUILD_VAR 环境变量；未设置则回落到 DS_BUILD_OPS
202	    ② builder.is_compatible()?  # 该算子在本机硬件/软件上能否编译
203	    ③ torch_available?          # 预编译必须有 torch
204	
205	    ①且②且③ → ext_modules.append(builder.builder())   # 预编译，打进 wheel
206	    否则     → 跳过，运行期首次使用时 JIT
207	```
208	
209	默认值由平台决定（[setup.py:L127-L130](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/setup.py#L127-L130)）：**Linux 默认不预编译（`0`），Windows 默认全预编译（`1`）**。Linux 选择 JIT 优先是为了让同一个 wheel 能在任何 GPU 架构上工作；Windows 上 JIT 体验差（需要管理员权限创建符号链接），所以倾向安装时编好。
210	
211	运行期的分岔则由安装时写下的 `installed_ops` 表驱动：
212	
213	```text
214	OpBuilder.load()
215	  ├─ installed_ops[name] 为 True 且加速器一致
216	  │    ├─ validate_torch_version / validate_torch_op_version  # 版本指纹校验
217	  │    └─ importlib.import_module(absolute_name())             # 直接加载预编译 .so
218	  └─ 否则 → jit_load()                                          # 现场编译并缓存
219	```

293	    ...

295	        assert torch_available, f"Unable to pre-compile {op_name}, please first install torch"

300	这段代码体现了"降级"的完整语义：torch 缺失时，即使你显式设置 `DS_BUILD_OPS=1`，预编译请求也会被 [setup.py:L132-L133](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/setup.py#L132-L133) 直接拒绝（`assert torch_available`）；而不设置开关时，一切算子静默留给 JIT。

306	```python
307	def load(self, verbose=False):
308	    if self.name in __class__._loaded_ops:
309	        return __class__._loaded_ops[self.name]
310	
311	    from deepspeed.git_version_info import installed_ops, torch_info, accelerator_name
312	    from deepspeed.accelerator import get_accelerator
313	    if installed_ops.get(self.name, False) and accelerator_name == get_accelerator()._name:
314	        self.validate_torch_version(torch_info)      # 版本指纹校验
315	        self.validate_torch_op_version(torch_info)
316	        op_module = importlib.import_module(self.absolute_name())  # 直接 import 预编译 .so
317	        ...
318	        return op_module
319	    else:
320	        return self.jit_load(verbose)                # 现场编译
321	```

380	
381	**练习 1**：在 Linux 上执行 `DS_BUILD_OPS=1 pip install -e .` 但机器上没装 torch，会发生什么？
382	
383	**答案**：安装直接失败。`DS_BUILD_OPS=1` 时 [setup.py:L132-L133](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/setup.py#L132-L133) 的断言 `assert torch_available, "Unable to pre-compile ops without torch installed..."` 触发。反过来若不设该变量，即使 torch 缺失安装也能成功（算子全部留给 JIT），这正是"降级"设计。

386	
387	**答案**：新增算子时只需在 `op_builder/` 下新建一个文件、定义一个 `XxxBuilder` 类，注册表自动收录（[op_builder/all_ops.py:L22-L32](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/all_ops.py#L22-L32)），不会出现"写了 Builder 却忘了注册"的疏漏；同时加速器厂商只需在自己的子目录（如 `op_builder/hpu/`、`op_builder/xpu/`）放实现，即可被同一机制发现。

390	
391	**答案**：`async_io` 的内核（`io_uring`/`libaio` 相关）是纯主机端代码，不需要 CUDA 工具链。此前它挂在 CUDA builder 下，依赖"`build_for_cpu`"这种"找不到 CUDA 工具链就悄悄退化成 CPU 编译"的模糊行为；#9085 删除了该退化路径，让"主机端算子"与"设备算子"各归其位——`async_io` 归 `CPUOpBuilder`，`gds` 复用它，语义更清晰，也让预编译与 JIT 两条路径给它生成同样的链接参数（缺 `-laio` 的加载失败由此修复）。

394	
395	### 4.3 arch 列表与 BF16 可用性规则：#9085 的修复
396	
397	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
398	
399	CUDA 算子编译时有两大"配置旋钮"：**给哪些架构生成代码**（arch 列表）与**是否启用 BF16 内核**（`BF16_AVAILABLE` 宏）。本周期 #9085（提交 `e35282bdb`，"Fix multiple issues in Op Builder and refactor implementation"）集中修了这一层的四个问题：
400	
401	1. **架构列表泄漏**：有些算子声明了最低支持的 compute capability（如 fp_quantizer 要求 >= 8.0），构建时会把自己的目标列表**过滤**后再用。修复前，过滤后的列表会被写回 `TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST` 环境变量——而 setup.py 在**同一个进程**里按字典序逐个构建所有算子，于是排在 fp_quantizer 之后的每个算子都继承了这份被削减的列表。提交说明给出的实测：请求 `7.0;7.5;8.0;9.0` 时，**10 个算子出厂时缺了 sm_70/sm_75 代码**，在 Volta/Turing 老卡上直接无法加载。
402	2. **BF16 内核被 pre-Ampere 目标"一票否决"**：旧规则是"所有目标都 >= sm_80 才启用 `BF16_AVAILABLE`"。默认架构列表里含 6.x/7.x，所以全量预编译时 `transformer_inference`、`inference_core_ops` 等算子根本没有 bf16 内核，88 个相关算子测试失败。而 nvcc 12.2+ 能为 pre-Ampere 目标编译这些内核（在 float 中计算 bf16 算术），所以新规则改为：**目标全为 Ampere+ 即启用；否则只要 nvcc >= 12.2 也启用**，老工具链保持旧规则。
403	3. **CUDA 13 默认列表**：默认列表 `"6.0;6.1;7.0"` 在 CUDA 13 下一项都编不了（CUDA 13 不再支持 7.5 以下架构），默认预编译直接失败。现在 CUDA 13 起默认列表改为从 7.5 开始。
404	4. **CUDA 版本检查表过时**：旧实现用一张手工维护的次版本兼容表（`cuda_minor_mismatch_ok`），每出新的 CUDA 版本都要先测再补，CUDA 13 没有条目导致 torch(CUDA 13.0) + nvcc 13.1 被误判不兼容。新实现改用 PyTorch 自己的规则：**主版本不匹配报错（`DS_SKIP_CUDA_CHECK=1` 可强行放行），次版本不匹配仅告警**，并且 JIT 路径也纳入检查（PyTorch 的 `load()` 本来不查）。
405	
406	顺带被删除的还有 `csrc/includes/compat.h` 兼容层与 `version_dependent_macros`——它们只服务于 torch 1.x，如今最低要求已是 torch>=2.0。

408	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
409	
410	`CUDAOpBuilder.compute_capability_args()` 是 arch 决策的中枢，JIT 与预编译两种模式走向不同出口：
411	
412	```text
413	compute_capability_args()
414	  │
415	  ├─ jit_mode = True（运行期 JIT，为"眼前这台机器"编）
416	  │    优先级：jit_load() 暂存的调用方 TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST
417	  │          > 环境变量 TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST
418	  │          > 探测可见 GPU 的真实架构
419	  │          > （fork 子进程中无显式列表 → 直接报错，避免污染 CUDA 上下文）
420	  │    过滤 + 去重 + 给最高无后缀架构补 +PTX
421	  │    → 把过滤后的列表写入 TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST、返回 []
422	  │      （让 PyTorch 自己生成 -gencode；jit_load() 结束后恢复调用方原值）
423	  │
424	  └─ jit_mode = False（setup.py 预编译，为"别的机器"编）
425	       优先级：TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST > get_default_compute_capabilities()
426	       过滤 + 去重 + 给最高无后缀架构补 +PTX
427	       → 直接返回显式 -gencode 参数，【不碰】TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST
428	         （setup.py 单进程构建全部算子，每个算子都必须从"请求的列表"出发）
429	```
430	
431	BF16 决策挂在同一条链上：
432	
433	```text
434	enable_bf16 = 所有目标架构 major >= 8 ?
435	              或 (存在 CUDA 工具链 且 nvcc 版本 >= (12, 2))
436	enable_bf16 → 给 cxx/nvcc 参数追加 -DBF16_AVAILABLE、
437	              并 -U__CUDA_NO_BFLOAT16*__ 一组宏（解除 nvcc 对 bf16 运算符的默认禁用）
438	```

621	   pytest tests/unit/ops/test_op_builder.py -v -k "test_bf16_kernels_are_built_for_pre_ampere_targets_only_from_nvcc_12_2"
622	   ```
623	
624	**需要观察的现象**：
625	
626	- 步骤 1 两条测试全绿；`-v` 输出里 BF16 测试按参数展开成 3 条子用例。
627	- 步骤 3 的推演结论：请求 `7.0;7.5;8.0;9.0` 时，所有排在过滤算子之后、且自身不声明 `MIN_COMPUTE_CAPABILITY` 的算子都丢了 sm_70/sm_75——提交说明统计为 10 个算子。
628	
629	**预期结果**：能用一句话向同伴解释"为什么预编译出口必须返回显式 `-gencode` 而不是写环境变量"（答案：setup.py 单进程构建全部算子，环境变量是进程级共享状态，写它会让后续算子继承被削减的列表）。（pytest 实际输出待本地验证。）
630	
631	#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案
632	
633	**练习 1**：为什么 JIT 分支可以写 `TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST`，预编译分支却不可以？
634	
635	**答案**：写环境变量的影响范围是整个进程。JIT 发生在运行期，一次只构建一个算子，且 [CUDAOpBuilder.jit_load()](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/builder.py#L841-L858) 用 try/finally 保证结束后恢复调用方原值；预编译发生在 setup.py 的**单个进程**里，所有算子依次构建，任何一个算子写环境变量都会污染后续算子——fp_quantizer 过滤后的 `8.0;9.0` 曾这样"泄漏"给后面 10 个算子。所以预编译分支改为返回显式 `-gencode` 旗标（[L755-L767](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/builder.py#L755-L767)），各算子互不干扰。
636	
637	**练习 2**：nvcc 12.1 与 12.4 下，同样的目标列表 `7.0;8.0;9.0` 编出的算子在 BF16 上有何差别？
638	
639	**答案**：12.1 下 `all(cc.major >= 8)` 为 False 且版本 < (12, 2)，`BF16_AVAILABLE` 不定义——pre-Ampere 目标上编译 BF16 内核会失败，干脆整个算子不带 bf16 路径；12.4 下第二条件命中，宏被定义，nvcc 在 7.0 目标上用 float 模拟 bf16 算术，老卡（如 V100，对应 issue #6839 一类失败）也能跑 bf16 内核。这正是 [tests/unit/ops/test_op_builder.py:L178-L186](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/tests/unit/ops/test_op_builder.py#L178-L186) 参数表覆盖的三种组合。
640	
641	**练习 3**：torch 用 CUDA 13.0 编译、系统 nvcc 是 13.1，修复前后各会发生什么？
642	
643	**答案**：修复前，手工维护的 `cuda_minor_mismatch_ok` 表没有 CUDA 13 的条目，`assert_no_cuda_mismatch()` 抛 `CUDAMismatchException`，构建直接失败——每出一个新 CUDA 版本都得先人工测试再补表。修复后按 PyTorch 的规则处理：主版本一致（13 == 13）、次版本不一致只打警告（[op_builder/builder.py:L193-L197](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/builder.py#L193-L197)），构建继续。

646	
647	### 4.4 版本指纹、双轨 op_builder 与 install.sh
648	
649	#### 4.4.1 概念说明
650	
651	前三个模块分别讲了"装什么依赖"、"怎么决定编哪些算子"和"怎么选架构与精度宏"。本模块补齐剩下的拼图：
652	
653	- **版本指纹**：安装时把版本、git 哈希、已装算子表、torch/CUDA 版本写进一个 Python 文件，运行期直接 import 它，据此判断"预编译的算子还能不能用"。
654	- **双轨 op_builder**：顶层 `op_builder/`（安装期视角）与 `deepspeed/ops/op_builder`（运行期视角）看起来是两个包路径，实际在 Linux/macOS 上是**符号链接**指向同一批文件；Windows 不支持开发期符号链接，setup.py 会在构建 wheel 时把它复制成实体目录。
655	
656	#### 4.4.2 核心流程
657	
658	版本字符串的组装规则（[setup.py:L228-L246](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/setup.py#L228-L246)）：
659	
660	```text
661	读取 version.txt (0.20.1)
662	  ├─ 设置了 DS_BUILD_STRING ？ → 追加构建后缀（官方发 wheel 用），写入 build.txt
663	  ├─ 存在 build.txt ？         → 追加其中的内容（从分发包安装）
664	  └─ 否则（源码安装）          → 追加 "+<git 短哈希>"
665	= 最终 version_str
666	```
667	
668	随后 [setup.py:L267-L282](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/setup.py#L267-L282) 收集 `torch_info`（torch 版本、bf16 支持、CUDA/NCCL/HIP 版本，CPU-only 时各版本记为 `"0.0"`），把版本串、git 信息、`install_ops` 表、加速器名、`torch_info` 一起**写死**到 `deepspeed/git_version_info_installed.py`。安装产物与运行期的对接点在 [deepspeed/git_version_info.py:L6-L24](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/deepspeed/git_version_info.py#L6-L24)：能导入安装生成的文件就用它；导不进（比如未安装的源码树、readthedocs 环境）则回退——版本读 `version.txt`，`installed_ops` 由 `ALL_OPS` 生成全 `False` 字典，`torch_info` 各项填 `"0.0"` 哨兵值，交给运行期自行探测。
669	
670	双轨结构的切换逻辑在 [op_builder/__init__.py:L17-L22](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/__init__.py#L17-L22)：优先把自己挂到 `deepspeed.ops.op_builder` 命名空间下（运行期），失败才退回顶层 `op_builder`（安装期）。安装期 torch 可能还没装，无法立即实例化 Builder，于是返回一个**闭包**延迟到运行期再构造（[op_builder/__init__.py:L28-L42](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/__init__.py#L28-L42) 的 `builder_closure`）。
671	
672	#### 4.4.3 源码精读
673	
674	**（1）符号链接证据。** 在仓库里直接可见：
675	
676	```text
677	deepspeed/ops/csrc        -> ../../csrc          （内核源码）
678	deepspeed/ops/op_builder  -> ../../op_builder    （编译配方）
679	```
680	
681	所以"安装期工具"与"运行期模块"共享同一份源码，`MANIFEST.in`（[L6-L9](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/MANIFEST.in#L6-L9)）确保 `csrc/`、`op_builder/`、`accelerator/` 里的文件也进 wheel——JIT 模式下用户机器上必须有源码才能现场编译。（#9085 删除了 `csrc/includes/compat.h`，但该目录下的其他公共头文件如 `cpu_adam.h`、`conversion_utils.h` 等仍在。）
682	
683	**（2）Windows 的实体复制。** [setup.py:L216-L226](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/setup.py#L216-L226) 在 win32 平台上 `shutil.rmtree` 删除包内的链接目录、`shutil.copytree` 把 `csrc/`、`op_builder/`、`accelerator/` 复制进 `deepspeed/ops/` 下——这也呼应了 setup.py 文件头（[L8-L18](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/setup.py#L8-L18)）"Windows 构建需管理员权限创建符号链接目录"的说明。
684	
685	**（3）版本指纹文件。** 安装时写入的关键内容（[setup.py:L276-L282](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/setup.py#L276-L282)）：
686	
687	```python
688	with open('deepspeed/git_version_info_installed.py', 'w') as fd:
689	    fd.write(f"version='{version_str}'\n")
690	    fd.write(f"git_hash='{git_hash}'\n")
691	    fd.write(f"git_branch='{git_branch}'\n")
692	    fd.write(f"installed_ops={install_ops}\n")
693	    fd.write(f"accelerator_name='{accelerator_name}'\n")
694	    fd.write(f"torch_info={torch_info}\n")
695	```
696	
697	`installed_ops` 与 `accelerator_name` 正是 4.2 中 `OpBuilder.load()` 分岔判断的数据来源：换了加速器或换了 torch 版本，预编译算子即被判为不可用，自动转 JIT 或报出清晰的版本不匹配错误。`install.sh` 的清理步骤（[install.sh:L128-L134](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/install.sh#L128-L134)）每次构建前删除旧的 `deepspeed/git_version_info_installed.py`、`dist`、`build`，避免陈旧指纹污染新 wheel。
698	
699	**（4）多机安装脚本。** [install.sh:L154-L161](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/install.sh#L154-L161) 本机路径：`python -m build --wheel --no-isolation` 构建 wheel → `pip install dist/deepspeed*.whl` → 运行 `ds_report` 自检；存在 hostfile 时则走 [install.sh:L163-L181](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/install.sh#L163-L181)，用 `pdsh`/`pdcp` 把 wheel 和 requirements 分发到所有节点逐一安装——这在 GPU 集群上保证每台机器的编译环境一致。

758	## 6. 本讲小结
759	
760	- **extras 体系**：DeepSpeed 把依赖外置到 `requirements/*.txt`，setup.py 装配成 `install_requires` + 9 个 extras 组 + 自动求并集的 `[all]`；`nvidia-ml-py` 等硬件相关依赖按加速器类型条件追加。
761	- **ALL_OPS 注册表**：通过反射扫描 `op_builder/` 下所有 `*Builder` 类自动生成，每个算子用 `BUILD_VAR` + `absolute_name()` + `sources()` 完成声明式注册；#9085 后预编译与 JIT 共享同一批编译钩子，两条路径拿到的 flag 完全一致。
762	- **三种编译路径**：Linux 上 pip 默认安装不预编译任何算子（`DS_BUILD_OPS=0`）；设 `DS_BUILD_OPS=1` 或单个 `DS_BUILD_*` 变量触发预编译；未预编译的算子在运行期首次使用时经 `OpBuilder.load()` → `jit_load()` 现场 JIT，产物缓存在 `~/.cache/torch_extensions`（或 `TORCH_EXTENSIONS_DIR`）。
763	- **arch 列表规则（#9085）**：默认列表按 CUDA 版本扩展，CUDA 13 起从 7.5 起步；JIT 优先 `TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST`（写入过滤后的列表并由 `jit_load` 恢复原值），预编译返回显式 `-gencode` 且不碰环境变量——修复了"过滤算子把削减后的列表泄漏给后续算子、10 个算子缺 sm_70/sm_75"的问题；两条路径都给最高无后缀架构补 `+PTX`。
764	- **BF16 可用性（#9085）**：目标全为 Ampere+ 即启用 `BF16_AVAILABLE`；否则 nvcc >= 12.2 也启用（pre-Ampere 上以 float 模拟 bf16 算术），老工具链保持旧规则。
765	- **CUDA 版本检查（#9085）**：手工兼容表换成 PyTorch 规则——主版本不匹配报错（`DS_SKIP_CUDA_CHECK=1` 可跳过）、次版本不匹配仅告警，且 JIT 路径也被纳入检查。
766	- **版本指纹与双轨**：安装时把 `installed_ops`/`torch_info` 写入 `git_version_info_installed.py`，运行期据此选择"直接 import 预编译 .so"或"转 JIT"，并做 torch/CUDA 版本防漂移校验；顶层 `op_builder/` 与 `deepspeed/ops/op_builder` 经符号链接共享同一份源码（Windows 复制实体）。

# 安装与构建：setup.py 与 CUDA 算子编译

## 1. 本讲目标

上一讲我们画好了仓库的代码地图，知道了 `deepspeed/` 是运行期主包、`op_builder/` 是安装期工具、`csrc/` 是 CUDA 内核源码。本讲回答一个衔接性的问题：**这三个目录是如何在"安装"这个时刻被粘合在一起的？**

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 读懂 `setup.py` 的完整执行流程，解释"torch 未安装时降级为 JIT 编译"的机制。
2. 说出 `ALL_OPS` 注册表是如何通过反射自动发现的，以及每个算子的 `BUILD_VAR`（如 `DS_BUILD_CPU_ADAM`）如何控制预编译。
3. 区分三种算子编译路径：纯 pip 安装（不编译）、`DS_BUILD_OPS=1` 预编译、运行时 JIT 编译。
4. 描述默认 compute capability（GPU 架构版本）的推导逻辑，理解 `TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST` 的作用，包括本周期 #9085 带来的变化：**CUDA 13 的默认架构列表更新**。
5. 解释 #9085 修复的「架构列表泄漏」问题：过滤目标的算子（如 fp_quantizer）为什么不再把缩减后的列表写回 `TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST`，以及这个 bug 如何让 10 个算子丢掉 sm_70/sm_75 代码。
6. 解释 #9085 修改后的 `BF16_AVAILABLE` 启用规则：为什么 nvcc >= 12.2 时即使目标包含 pre-Ampere 架构也启用 BF16 内核。
7. 理解安装产物 `deepspeed/git_version_info_installed.py` 如何记录"哪些算子已被预编译"，从而决定运行期走预编译加载还是 JIT。

## 2. 前置知识

阅读本讲前，你需要了解以下概念（不熟悉也没关系，下面用两三句话解释）：

- **Python 打包（setuptools）**：`setup.py` 是 Python 项目的"装机说明书"。`pip install .` 时，pip 会执行这个文件，文件里的 `setup(...)` 调用声明了包名、版本、依赖和要编译的扩展模块。`ext_modules` 参数列出的 C++/CUDA 扩展会在安装时被编译成 `.so`（Linux 共享库）文件。
- **CUDA 与 nvcc**：CUDA 是 NVIDIA 的 GPU 编程工具链，`nvcc` 是它的编译器。CUDA C++ 源码（`.cu` 文件）必须用 `nvcc` 编译。
- **compute capability（计算能力，简称 CC）**：NVIDIA 给每代 GPU 标的一个版本号，如 A100 是 8.0、H100 是 9.0。编译 CUDA 代码时必须指定目标架构（生成 `-gencode` 编译参数），架构不匹配则无法运行。习惯上把 8.0（Ampere）之前的架构叫 **pre-Ampere**（如 7.0 Volta、7.5 Turing）。
- **sm_XX 与 PTX**：`sm_XX` 是针对具体架构的机器码；`compute_XX`（PTX）是一种中间表示，驱动可以在**更新**的架构上把它即时翻译成机器码执行。所以给最高目标架构附带 `+PTX` 是一种"向前兼容"兜底。
- **`TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST`**：PyTorch 约定的环境变量，用分号或空格分隔的目标架构列表（如 `"8.0;9.0"`，支持 `9.0a`、`10.0+PTX` 这类后缀）。预编译与 JIT 两条路径都读它；本讲的 4.3 节会看到它在 #9085 前后语义上的关键差别。
- **BF16**：bfloat16，一种指数位与 fp32 相同、尾数位更少的浮点格式。Ampere（8.x）及以后的 GPU 有原生 BF16 算术指令；更老的 GPU 上编译 BF16 内核需要 nvcc 12.2+ 用 float 模拟（详见 4.3）。
- **JIT（Just-In-Time，即时编译）**：与安装时预编译（AOT，Ahead-Of-Time）相对。JIT 指程序**运行中第一次用到某个算子时**才现场编译它，编译产物缓存在磁盘上，下次直接复用。
- **ninja**：一个轻量构建工具，PyTorch 的 `torch.utils.cpp_extension.load()` 用它来加速扩展编译。DeepSpeed 把 `ninja` 直接列为基础依赖。
- **环境变量开关**：DeepSpeed 大量使用"环境变量当开关"的模式，如 `DS_BUILD_OPS=1`、`DS_BUILD_AIO=1`。本讲会看到它们在源码中如何被读取。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 角色 |
|---|---|
| [setup.py](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/setup.py) | 安装总入口：探测 torch、遍历算子注册表、决定预编译哪些扩展、生成版本信息文件 |
| [op_builder/builder.py](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/builder.py) | `OpBuilder` / `CUDAOpBuilder` 基类：算子的"编译配方"，含 compute capability 推导、BF16 规则与 JIT 加载（本周期 #9085 全面重构） |
| [op_builder/all_ops.py](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/all_ops.py) | 用反射自动发现所有 Builder 类，汇成 `ALL_OPS` 注册表 |
| [op_builder/cpu/cpu_adam.py](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/cpu/cpu_adam.py) | 一个具体算子的 Builder 样例（CPUAdam），展示"几行描述一个算子"的写法 |
| [op_builder/fp_quantizer.py](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/fp_quantizer.py) | 会过滤架构目标的算子样例：`MIN_COMPUTE_CAPABILITY = 8`（4.3 节的主角） |
| [requirements/requirements.txt](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/requirements/requirements.txt) | 基础依赖表；同目录下其余 `requirements-*.txt` 是各 extras 的依赖表 |
| [install.sh](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/install.sh) | 多机安装脚本：构建 wheel 并通过 pdsh 分发到 hostfile 列出的所有机器 |
| [deepspeed/git_version_info.py](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/deepspeed/git_version_info.py) | 运行期读取安装信息的入口：优先读安装时生成的 `git_version_info_installed.py` |
| [deepspeed/ops/adam/cpu_adam.py](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/deepspeed/ops/adam/cpu_adam.py) | 运行期触发 JIT 的调用点样例：`CPUAdamBuilder().load()` |
| [tests/unit/ops/test_op_builder.py](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/tests/unit/ops/test_op_builder.py) | #9085 配套的回归测试：架构列表不泄漏、BF16 规则、CUDA 版本检查等（本周期大幅扩充） |

---

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 setup.py 的 extras 体系与 requirements 依赖表

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

一个 Python 包的依赖分两类：

- **install_requires（基础依赖）**：任何用户装了这个包就一定需要的库。
- **extras_require（可选依赖组）**：按功能划分的可选集合，用户用 `pip install deepspeed[dev]` 这样的语法按需安装。

DeepSpeed 把"哪些依赖属于基础、哪些属于可选"完全外置到 `requirements/` 目录下的一组文本文件里，`setup.py` 只是逐个读取。这样做的好处是：依赖清单可以被 CI、Dockerfile、conda 环境文件（`environment.yml`）等其他工具直接复用，不必重复维护。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

```text
requirements/requirements.txt ──────────────┐  (基础依赖 install_requires)
requirements/requirements-dev.txt ──────────┤
requirements/requirements-autotuning.txt ───┤
requirements/requirements-autotuning-ml.txt ┤
requirements/requirements-inf.txt ──────────┼─► fetch_requirements() 逐个读入
requirements/requirements-sd.txt ───────────┤     ↓
requirements/requirements-deepcompile.txt ──┤   extras_require 字典
requirements/requirements-torchembed.txt ───┤     ↓
requirements/requirements-readthedocs.txt ──┘   求并集 → extras_require['all']
```

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

先看 setup.py 开头的 torch 探测——这是整个安装流程的第一道分岔口：

[setup.py:L32-L38](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/setup.py#L32-L38)

```python
torch_available = True
try:
    import torch
except ImportError:
    torch_available = False
    print('[WARNING] Unable to import torch, pre-compiling ops will be disabled. ...')
```

这段代码尝试导入 torch，失败时只打印警告并把 `torch_available` 置为 `False`，**不会让安装失败**。这就是"torch 未安装时降级"的第一步：安装可以成功，但所有需要 torch 的编译步骤都会被跳过，算子留待运行时 JIT。

接着 setup.py 从安装期专属的顶层 `op_builder/` 和 `accelerator/` 目录导入工具（这两个目录在 u1-l2 已见过，它们不属于 `deepspeed` 包，只服务于安装阶段）：

[setup.py:L40-L43](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/setup.py#L40-L43)

```python
from op_builder import get_default_compute_capabilities, OpBuilder
from op_builder.all_ops import ALL_OPS, accelerator_name

from accelerator import get_accelerator
```

然后是依赖装载。`fetch_requirements` 只是把文本文件按行读成列表：

[setup.py:L58-L60](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/setup.py#L58-L60)

```python
def fetch_requirements(path):
    with open(path, 'r') as fd:
        return [r.strip() for r in fd.readlines()]
```

[setup.py:L79-L90](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/setup.py#L79-L90) 把 9 个依赖文件装配成 `extras_require` 字典，键就是 pip 的 extras 名，例如 `pip install deepspeed[autotuning]` 会装上 `requirements-autotuning.txt` 里的内容。注意 `'triton': []` 是空列表——注释说明这是为了向后兼容保留的键，如今 Triton 由 PyTorch 自带：

```python
install_requires = fetch_requirements('requirements/requirements.txt')
extras_require = {
    'readthedocs': ..., 'dev': ..., 'autotuning': ..., 'autotuning_ml': ...,
    'inf': ..., 'sd': ..., 'triton': [], 'deepcompile': ..., 'torchembed': ...,
}
```

[setup.py:L96-L101](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/setup.py#L96-L101) 对所有 extras 求并集，生成一个"全家桶"组 `[all]`。此外 [setup.py:L92-L94](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/setup.py#L92-L94) 有一处条件依赖：仅当 torch 可用、加速器是 CUDA 且非 ROCm 时，才把 `nvidia-ml-py`（NVML 的 Python 绑定）追加进基础依赖——这是"按硬件条件裁剪依赖"的范例。

基础依赖本体只有 11 行（[requirements/requirements.txt:L1-L11](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/requirements/requirements.txt#L1-L11)）：

```text
einops
hjson
msgpack
ninja
numpy
packaging>=20.0
psutil
py-cpuinfo
pydantic>=2.0.0
torch>=2.0.0
tqdm
```

值得注意的三个成员：

- `torch>=2.0.0`：torch 本身就是基础依赖，所以正常 `pip install deepspeed` 装完后 torch 一定存在；"torch 未安装"的场景主要出现在**先装 deepspeed 后装 torch**，或用 `--no-deps` 安装时。
- `ninja`：JIT 编译的必备工具，DeepSpeed 干脆把它声明成硬依赖（运行期 JIT 时若 ninja 缺失会直接报错，见 4.2 的 `jit_load`）。
- `py-cpuinfo`：用于探测 CPU 型号与指令集（AVX512/NEON/SVE 等），CPU 算子（如 cpu_adam）据此选择向量化编译参数。#9085 还给它加了 `lscpu` 兜底与 Apple Silicon 修复（见 4.2.3）。

#### 4.1.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：亲眼确认 extras 体系的行为差异——装与不装 `dev` 组，环境里多出哪些包。

**操作步骤**：

1. 创建干净虚拟环境并只装基础包：`python -m venv ~/venv-ds-base && ~/venv-ds-base/bin/pip install -e .`
2. 记录包列表：`~/venv-ds-base/bin/pip list > base.txt`
3. 再创建一个环境装 dev 组：`python -m venv ~/venv-ds-dev && ~/venv-ds-dev/bin/pip install -e .[dev]`
4. 对比：`diff base.txt <(~/venv-ds-dev/bin/pip list)`（或肉眼比对）。

**需要观察的现象**：`dev` 环境额外出现 `pytest`、`pre-commit`、`transformers`、`tensorboard`、`wandb` 等开发期工具（对应 [requirements/requirements-dev.txt](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/requirements/requirements-dev.txt) 的内容）。

**预期结果**：两个环境都能 `import deepspeed` 成功——证明 dev 组的包对运行并非必需。（本实践涉及真实 pip 安装，若网络受限，预期结果待本地验证。）

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 `nvidia-ml-py` 不直接写进 `requirements.txt`，而要在 setup.py 里条件追加？

**答案**：`nvidia-ml-py` 只对 NVIDIA GPU 有意义。若写死在基础依赖里，CPU/ROCm/其他加速器用户也会被迫安装它。setup.py 在 [L92-L94](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/setup.py#L92-L94) 里通过 `get_accelerator().device_name() == 'cuda'` 探测当前硬件，只在 NVIDIA 环境追加，实现了按硬件裁剪。

**练习 2**：`pip install deepspeed[triton]` 会多装什么？

**答案**：什么也不会多装。`'triton': []` 是空列表（[setup.py:L87](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/setup.py#L87)），注释写明它是为向后兼容保留的键——新版 PyTorch 已自带 Triton。

**练习 3**：`fetch_requirements` 极其简单，为什么不直接在 setup.py 里硬编码依赖列表？

**答案**：依赖外置成纯文本后，`requirements/` 目录可被 CI 配置、Dockerfile、`environment.yml`、`install.sh`（多机分发时会 `pdcp requirements/requirements.txt`）等场景直接引用，单一数据源避免多处维护漂移。

---

### 4.2 OpBuilder 构建入口：ALL_OPS 注册表与三条编译路径

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

`OpBuilder` 是每个 CUDA/C++ 算子的"编译配方"。DeepSpeed 有约 20 个算子（fused_adam、cpu_adam、async_io、transformer……），如果每个都写一份编译脚本会大量重复。做法是：定义一个基类把"编译一个算子"的通用逻辑（找源码、探测 CUDA 版本、生成架构参数、调用编译器）全部封装，每个具体算子只需声明三件事：

1. **`BUILD_VAR`**：控制自己预编译的环境变量名，如 `DS_BUILD_CPU_ADAM`。
2. **`absolute_name()`**：编译产物（`.so`）的 Python 模块全名。
3. **`sources()`**：源码文件相对路径列表。

`ALL_OPS` 则是"算子名 → Builder 实例"的注册表，它**不是手写的**，而是用反射扫描 `op_builder/` 目录下所有以 `Builder` 结尾的类自动生成。

本周期 #9085 对这一层做了一次架构级重构，两条核心设计变化需要先记住：

- **`OpBuilder` 基类变成加速器中立**：不再检查 CUDA/ROCm，编译与 JIT 加载都走钩子（`extra_compile_args()`、`jit_load_kwargs()`、`libraries_args()`、`validate_torch_op_version()`）。`builder()`（预编译）与 `jit_load()`（JIT）**消费同一批钩子**，所以两条路径拿到完全相同的编译/链接参数——修复了此前"预编译与 JIT 用不同 flag"导致的链接错误（如 CPU 加速器上预编译的 `async_io` 缺 `-laio` 而加载失败）。
- **所有 CUDA/ROCm 专属逻辑集中到 `CUDAOpBuilder`**：nvcc 参数、架构列表、BF16 开关、CUDA 工具链检查都搬进这个子类；不需要 CUDA 的算子（如 `async_io`）改由 `CPUOpBuilder` 负责，顶层 `op_builder/async_io.py` 因此被删除。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

安装时 setup.py 对每个算子做一次"三问决策"：

```text
for op_name, builder in ALL_OPS.items():
    ① op_enabled(op_name)?      # 读算子的 BUILD_VAR 环境变量；未设置则回落到 DS_BUILD_OPS
    ② builder.is_compatible()?  # 该算子在本机硬件/软件上能否编译
    ③ torch_available?          # 预编译必须有 torch

    ①且②且③ → ext_modules.append(builder.builder())   # 预编译，打进 wheel
    否则     → 跳过，运行期首次使用时 JIT
```

默认值由平台决定（[setup.py:L127-L130](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/setup.py#L127-L130)）：**Linux 默认不预编译（`0`），Windows 默认全预编译（`1`）**。Linux 选择 JIT 优先是为了让同一个 wheel 能在任何 GPU 架构上工作；Windows 上 JIT 体验差（需要管理员权限创建符号链接），所以倾向安装时编好。

运行期的分岔则由安装时写下的 `installed_ops` 表驱动：

```text
OpBuilder.load()
  ├─ installed_ops[name] 为 True 且加速器一致
  │    ├─ validate_torch_version / validate_torch_op_version  # 版本指纹校验
  │    └─ importlib.import_module(absolute_name())             # 直接加载预编译 .so
  └─ 否则 → jit_load()                                          # 现场编译并缓存
```

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

**（1）注册表的自动发现。**

[op_builder/all_ops.py:L9-L13](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/all_ops.py#L9-L13) 先解决"安装期能否 import 到加速器模块"的问题：安装时顶层 `accelerator/` 可见，安装后（运行期）则改从 `deepspeed.accelerator` 导入——同一段代码适配两个生命周期阶段：

```python
try:
    # during installation time accelerator is visible, otherwise return deepspeed.accelerator
    from accelerator import get_accelerator
except ImportError:
    from deepspeed.accelerator import get_accelerator
```

[op_builder/all_ops.py:L18-L32](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/all_ops.py#L18-L32) 是注册表本体：用 `pkgutil.iter_modules` 遍历 op_builder 目录下的每个模块，把所有名字以 `Builder` 结尾的类交给加速器工厂实例化，最后汇成字典：

```python
op_builder_dir = get_accelerator().op_builder_dir()
op_builder_module = importlib.import_module(op_builder_dir)
for _, module_name, _ in pkgutil.iter_modules([os.path.dirname(op_builder_module.__file__)]):
    if module_name != 'all_ops' and module_name != 'builder':
        module = importlib.import_module("{}.{}".format(op_builder_dir, module_name))
        for member_name in module.__dir__():
            if member_name.endswith('Builder'):
                builder = get_accelerator().create_op_builder(member_name)
                __op_builders__.append(builder)

ALL_OPS = {op.name: op for op in __op_builders__ if op is not None}
```

注意加速器工厂的作用：在 CUDA 机器上 `FusedAdamBuilder` 会实例化为 CUDA 版 Builder，在 CPU/HPU 等机器上会换成对应加速器的实现（这就是 u3-l1 将讲的加速器抽象在本讲的首次露面）。

**（2）一个算子配方的样子。** 以 CPUAdam 为例，全文不到 30 行：

[op_builder/cpu/cpu_adam.py:L9-L27](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/cpu/cpu_adam.py#L9-L27)

```python
class CPUAdamBuilder(CPUOpBuilder):
    BUILD_VAR = "DS_BUILD_CPU_ADAM"
    NAME = "cpu_adam"

    def absolute_name(self):
        return f'deepspeed.ops.adam.{self.NAME}_op'

    def sources(self):
        return ['csrc/adam/cpu_adam.cpp', 'csrc/adam/cpu_adam_impl.cpp']

    def include_paths(self):
        return ['csrc/includes']
```

声明式到极致：编译哪个文件、编出来叫什么模块，仅此而已。基类 `OpBuilder` 在 [op_builder/builder.py:L220-L233](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/builder.py#L220-L233) 把这两个方法定为抽象方法，强迫每个子类提供。

**（3）setup.py 的决策主循环。**

[setup.py:L147-L155](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/setup.py#L147-L155) 定义"算子是否被启用"：优先读算子专属的 `BUILD_VAR`（如 `DS_BUILD_CPU_ADAM`），没设置则回落到总开关 `DS_BUILD_OPS`：

```python
def op_envvar(op_name):
    return ALL_OPS[op_name].BUILD_VAR

def op_enabled(op_name):
    env_var = op_envvar(op_name)
    return int(get_env_if_set(env_var, BUILD_OP_DEFAULT))
```

[setup.py:L158-L177](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/setup.py#L158-L177) 是主循环，处理"想编但不兼容"（打警告跳过）、"ROCm 上未启用但兼容"（做 hipify 转换备用）、"想编且兼容"（加入 `ext_modules` 预编译）三种组合，其中预编译分支还有一个兜底断言 `assert torch_available`：

```python
install_ops = dict.fromkeys(ALL_OPS.keys(), False)
for op_name, builder in ALL_OPS.items():
    op_compatible = builder.is_compatible()
    ...
    if op_enabled(op_name) and op_compatible:
        assert torch_available, f"Unable to pre-compile {op_name}, please first install torch"
        install_ops[op_name] = op_enabled(op_name)
        ext_modules.append(builder.builder())
```

这段代码体现了"降级"的完整语义：torch 缺失时，即使你显式设置 `DS_BUILD_OPS=1`，预编译请求也会被 [setup.py:L132-L133](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/setup.py#L132-L133) 直接拒绝（`assert torch_available`）；而不设置开关时，一切算子静默留给 JIT。

循环之后还有一个依赖修正逻辑（[setup.py:L179-L192](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/setup.py#L179-L192)）：`async_io` 和 `gds` 在运行期会连带触发 `pin_memory` 算子的 JIT，若前者被预编译而后者没有，无编译器的部署环境就会在运行时翻车——所以这里强制把 `pin_memory` 一起预编译。这是"预编译清单要闭合"的一个真实案例。

**（4）运行期：load 与 jit_load 的分岔。** 安装期讲完了，再看运行期如何"兑现"。[op_builder/builder.py:L489-L505](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/builder.py#L489-L505) 的 `load()` 是运行期加载算子的统一入口：

```python
def load(self, verbose=False):
    if self.name in __class__._loaded_ops:
        return __class__._loaded_ops[self.name]

    from deepspeed.git_version_info import installed_ops, torch_info, accelerator_name
    from deepspeed.accelerator import get_accelerator
    if installed_ops.get(self.name, False) and accelerator_name == get_accelerator()._name:
        self.validate_torch_version(torch_info)      # 版本指纹校验
        self.validate_torch_op_version(torch_info)
        op_module = importlib.import_module(self.absolute_name())  # 直接 import 预编译 .so
        ...
        return op_module
    else:
        return self.jit_load(verbose)                # 现场编译
```

判断依据正是安装时写入的 `installed_ops` 表。预编译路径还要做两道安全检查：`validate_torch_version` 确认运行期 torch 版本与安装时一致（[op_builder/builder.py:L238-L247](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/builder.py#L238-L247)），CUDA 算子再校验 CUDA/HIP 版本（[op_builder/builder.py:L564-L584](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/builder.py#L564-L584)）——版本漂移时给出明确报错而不是让程序崩溃在莫名的 ABI 错误上。

JIT 路径 [op_builder/builder.py:L513-L548](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/builder.py#L513-L548) 依次：兼容性检查 → 校验 ninja 可用 → 调 PyTorch 的 `torch.utils.cpp_extension.load()`，把 `sources()`/`include_paths()`/编译参数全部传过去（这些参数经 [jit_load_kwargs](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/builder.py#L507-L511) 与预编译路径共享同一来源），最终产物缓存在 PyTorch 决定的扩展目录里，并记入类级缓存 `_loaded_ops` 避免重复编译。注意 #9085 删掉了 DeepSpeed 自己的 `DEFAULT_TORCH_EXTENSION_PATH = "/tmp/torch_extensions"` 常量——缓存位置现在完全遵循 PyTorch `torch.utils.cpp_extension` 的规则：优先 `TORCH_EXTENSIONS_DIR` 环境变量，其次 `~/.cache/torch_extensions`（不可写时回退 `/tmp/torch_extensions`）。

调用它的真实业务代码长这样（[deepspeed/ops/adam/cpu_adam.py:L122](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/deepspeed/ops/adam/cpu_adam.py#L122)）：

```python
self.ds_opt_adam = CPUAdamBuilder().load()
```

当你在 ZeRO-Offload 里第一次用到 `DeepSpeedCPUAdam` 时，这一行就会触发 cpu_adam 的 JIT 编译（若它没被预编译）。

顺带一提 [op_builder/builder.py:L117-L129](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/builder.py#L117-L129) 的 `probe_is_compatible()`：`import deepspeed` 时（[deepspeed/ops/__init__.py:L18-L22](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/deepspeed/ops/__init__.py#L18-L22)）会对每个算子做兼容性探测，它把"探测本身抛异常"（如有 GPU 但没装 CUDA 工具链）也当作"不兼容"处理，避免一个你根本不会用的算子让 `import deepspeed` 整体失败。`ds_report`（下一讲）同样复用这个函数。

#### 4.2.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：完整观察"pip 安装（不预编译）→ 运行期 JIT → 编译缓存生成"三步，验证双路径的存在。

**操作步骤**：

1. 创建干净环境并安装（Linux 上 `DS_BUILD_OPS` 默认为 0，即不预编译）：

   ```bash
   python -m venv ~/venv-ds && source ~/venv-ds/bin/activate
   pip install -e . 2>&1 | tee install.log
   ```

2. 确认版本与安装信息（安装脚本会生成 `deepspeed/git_version_info_installed.py`）：

   ```bash
   python -c "import deepspeed; print(deepspeed.__version__)"
   python -c "from deepspeed.git_version_info import installed_ops; print(installed_ops)"
   ```

3. 记录缓存目录的初始状态（JIT 还没发生过，应为空或不存在）：

   ```bash
   ls /tmp/torch_extensions/ 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/torch_extensions/ 2>/dev/null
   ```

4. 主动触发一次 CPU 算子 JIT（cpu_adam 是纯 C++ 算子，**无 GPU 也能编**）：

   ```bash
   python -c "from deepspeed.ops.op_builder import CPUAdamBuilder; CPUAdamBuilder().load(verbose=True)"
   ```

5. 再次查看缓存目录：`ls -R ~/.cache/torch_extensions/ /tmp/torch_extensions/ 2>/dev/null`，找到 `cpu_adam` 子目录里的 `.so` 文件。

**需要观察的现象**：

- 步骤 2 中 `installed_ops` 打印出的所有算子值均为 `False`（因为 Linux 默认不预编译），版本号形如 `0.20.1+<git短哈希>`。
- 步骤 4 会输出一长串编译日志（首次约几十秒到几分钟），末尾打印加载成功。
- 步骤 5 出现 `cpu_adam` 编译产物目录与 `.so` 文件；第二次执行步骤 4 几乎瞬时完成（命中磁盘缓存与 `_loaded_ops` 内存缓存）。

**预期结果**：JIT 产物生成于 `~/.cache/torch_extensions/<python版本目录>/cpu_adam/`（HOME 不可写或设置了 `TORCH_EXTENSIONS_DIR` 时位置不同，以实际观察为准——此点待本地验证）。把 install.log 里 `DS_BUILD_OPS=0` 与 `Install Ops={...全 False...}` 两行截图归档，它们分别来自 [setup.py:L130](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/setup.py#L130) 和 [setup.py:L194](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/setup.py#L194)。

#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：在 Linux 上执行 `DS_BUILD_OPS=1 pip install -e .` 但机器上没装 torch，会发生什么？

**答案**：安装直接失败。`DS_BUILD_OPS=1` 时 [setup.py:L132-L133](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/setup.py#L132-L133) 的断言 `assert torch_available, "Unable to pre-compile ops without torch installed..."` 触发。反过来若不设该变量，即使 torch 缺失安装也能成功（算子全部留给 JIT），这正是"降级"设计。

**练习 2**：为什么 `ALL_OPS` 用反射扫描而不是手工维护一个列表？

**答案**：新增算子时只需在 `op_builder/` 下新建一个文件、定义一个 `XxxBuilder` 类，注册表自动收录（[op_builder/all_ops.py:L22-L32](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/all_ops.py#L22-L32)），不会出现"写了 Builder 却忘了注册"的疏漏；同时加速器厂商只需在自己的子目录（如 `op_builder/hpu/`、`op_builder/xpu/`）放实现，即可被同一机制发现。

**练习 3**：#9085 为什么把 `async_io` 从 CUDA builder 挪到 `CPUOpBuilder`？

**答案**：`async_io` 的内核（`io_uring`/`libaio` 相关）是纯主机端代码，不需要 CUDA 工具链。此前它挂在 CUDA builder 下，依赖"`build_for_cpu`"这种"找不到 CUDA 工具链就悄悄退化成 CPU 编译"的模糊行为；#9085 删除了该退化路径，让"主机端算子"与"设备算子"各归其位——`async_io` 归 `CPUOpBuilder`，`gds` 复用它，语义更清晰，也让预编译与 JIT 两条路径给它生成同样的链接参数（缺 `-laio` 的加载失败由此修复）。

### 4.3 arch 列表与 BF16 可用性规则：#9085 的修复

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

CUDA 算子编译时有两大"配置旋钮"：**给哪些架构生成代码**（arch 列表）与**是否启用 BF16 内核**（`BF16_AVAILABLE` 宏）。本周期 #9085（提交 `e35282bdb`，"Fix multiple issues in Op Builder and refactor implementation"）集中修了这一层的四个问题：

1. **架构列表泄漏**：有些算子声明了最低支持的 compute capability（如 fp_quantizer 要求 >= 8.0），构建时会把自己的目标列表**过滤**后再用。修复前，过滤后的列表会被写回 `TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST` 环境变量——而 setup.py 在**同一个进程**里按字典序逐个构建所有算子，于是排在 fp_quantizer 之后的每个算子都继承了这份被削减的列表。提交说明给出的实测：请求 `7.0;7.5;8.0;9.0` 时，**10 个算子出厂时缺了 sm_70/sm_75 代码**，在 Volta/Turing 老卡上直接无法加载。
2. **BF16 内核被 pre-Ampere 目标"一票否决"**：旧规则是"所有目标都 >= sm_80 才启用 `BF16_AVAILABLE`"。默认架构列表里含 6.x/7.x，所以全量预编译时 `transformer_inference`、`inference_core_ops` 等算子根本没有 bf16 内核，88 个相关算子测试失败。而 nvcc 12.2+ 能为 pre-Ampere 目标编译这些内核（在 float 中计算 bf16 算术），所以新规则改为：**目标全为 Ampere+ 即启用；否则只要 nvcc >= 12.2 也启用**，老工具链保持旧规则。
3. **CUDA 13 默认列表**：默认列表 `"6.0;6.1;7.0"` 在 CUDA 13 下一项都编不了（CUDA 13 不再支持 7.5 以下架构），默认预编译直接失败。现在 CUDA 13 起默认列表改为从 7.5 开始。
4. **CUDA 版本检查表过时**：旧实现用一张手工维护的次版本兼容表（`cuda_minor_mismatch_ok`），每出新的 CUDA 版本都要先测再补，CUDA 13 没有条目导致 torch(CUDA 13.0) + nvcc 13.1 被误判不兼容。新实现改用 PyTorch 自己的规则：**主版本不匹配报错（`DS_SKIP_CUDA_CHECK=1` 可强行放行），次版本不匹配仅告警**，并且 JIT 路径也纳入检查（PyTorch 的 `load()` 本来不查）。

顺带被删除的还有 `csrc/includes/compat.h` 兼容层与 `version_dependent_macros`——它们只服务于 torch 1.x，如今最低要求已是 torch>=2.0。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

`CUDAOpBuilder.compute_capability_args()` 是 arch 决策的中枢，JIT 与预编译两种模式走向不同出口：

```text
compute_capability_args()
  │
  ├─ jit_mode = True（运行期 JIT，为"眼前这台机器"编）
  │    优先级：jit_load() 暂存的调用方 TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST
  │          > 环境变量 TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST
  │          > 探测可见 GPU 的真实架构
  │          > （fork 子进程中无显式列表 → 直接报错，避免污染 CUDA 上下文）
  │    过滤 + 去重 + 给最高无后缀架构补 +PTX
  │    → 把过滤后的列表写入 TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST、返回 []
  │      （让 PyTorch 自己生成 -gencode；jit_load() 结束后恢复调用方原值）
  │
  └─ jit_mode = False（setup.py 预编译，为"别的机器"编）
       优先级：TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST > get_default_compute_capabilities()
       过滤 + 去重 + 给最高无后缀架构补 +PTX
       → 直接返回显式 -gencode 参数，【不碰】TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST
         （setup.py 单进程构建全部算子，每个算子都必须从"请求的列表"出发）
```

BF16 决策挂在同一条链上：

```text
enable_bf16 = 所有目标架构 major >= 8 ?
              或 (存在 CUDA 工具链 且 nvcc 版本 >= (12, 2))
enable_bf16 → 给 cxx/nvcc 参数追加 -DBF16_AVAILABLE、
              并 -U__CUDA_NO_BFLOAT16*__ 一组宏（解除 nvcc 对 bf16 运算符的默认禁用）
```

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

**（1）默认架构列表与 CUDA 13。** 基类顶部的保守默认值（[op_builder/builder.py:L24](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/builder.py#L24)）：

```python
DEFAULT_COMPUTE_CAPABILITIES = "6.0;6.1;7.0"
```

（#9085 同时删掉了它旁边的 `DEFAULT_TORCH_EXTENSION_PATH` 常量，缓存目录交由 PyTorch 决定，见 4.2。）[op_builder/builder.py:L132-L151](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/builder.py#L132-L151) 的 `get_default_compute_capabilities()` 按本机 CUDA 大版本扩展这个基线，**新增的 CUDA 13 分支是本周期变化**：

```python
compute_caps = DEFAULT_COMPUTE_CAPABILITIES        # "6.0;6.1;7.0"
if installed_cuda_version()[0] == 11:
    ...逐级追加 "8.0" / "8.6" / "9.0"
elif installed_cuda_version()[0] == 12:
    compute_caps += ";8.0;8.6;9.0"
    if installed_cuda_version()[1] >= 8:
        compute_caps += ";10.0;12.0"
elif installed_cuda_version()[0] >= 13:
    # CUDA 13 cannot build for compute capabilities below 7.5, which rules out the whole base list
    compute_caps = "7.5;8.0;8.6;9.0;10.0;12.0"
```

也就是说：CUDA 12 环境下默认给 6.0～9.0（12.8 起含 10.0/12.0）全部编一遍——预编译的 wheel 因此"通吃"大多数 GPU，代价是编译时间成倍增长；CUDA 13 环境下则从 7.5 起步（7.5 以下编不了，基线整个作废）。这也解释了为什么 Linux 默认走 JIT：JIT 只编"眼前这块卡"的架构，编译又快又省。

其中反复调用的 `installed_cuda_version()` 现在带着一层进程级缓存（[op_builder/builder.py:L43-L67](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/builder.py#L43-L67)）：`nvcc -V` 的输出解析被包进 `@functools.lru_cache` 的 `_nvcc_version()`——每个算子都问一遍工具链版本，但同一个 nvcc 路径在一个进程里只真正执行一次（CPU 探测、`rocminfo` 同理）。

**（2）架构列表的解析。** #9085 引入了统一的 `CudaArch` 类型与解析器，JIT 和预编译两条路径共用（[op_builder/builder.py:L154-L182](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/builder.py#L154-L182)）：

```python
class CudaArch(NamedTuple):
    """One TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST entry, such as 8.0, 9.0a or 10.0+PTX."""
    major: int
    minor: int
    suffix: str    # "a" marks an architecture-specific target
    ptx: bool

def _parse_cuda_arch_list(arch_list):
    ...
    match = re.fullmatch(r"(\d+)\.(\d+)(a?)(\+PTX)?", entry)
    if match is None:
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST entry '{entry}'. ...")
```

修复前的两个坑：`9.0a`（Hopper/Blackwell 上架构特化的 TMA 等特性需要它）与带空项的 `8.0;8.6;` 都会 `ValueError` 崩溃；现在 `a` 后缀、`+PTX` 都被正确支持，`Ampere` 这类含糊的名字则给出清晰报错。

**（3）会过滤架构的算子。** `CUDAOpBuilder` 定义了类属性 `MIN_COMPUTE_CAPABILITY`（[op_builder/builder.py:L553-L556](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/builder.py#L553-L556)），[filter_ccs()](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/builder.py#L769-L780) 据此砍掉太老的目标并打警告。fp_quantizer 就是一个典型（[op_builder/fp_quantizer.py:L9-L12](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/fp_quantizer.py#L9-L12)）：

```python
class FPQuantizerBuilder(CUDAOpBuilder):
    BUILD_VAR = "DS_BUILD_FP_QUANTIZER"
    NAME = "fp_quantizer"
    MIN_COMPUTE_CAPABILITY = 8
```

仓库里声明了这个属性的算子还有 `evoformer_attn`（7）、`inference_core_ops`（6）、`inference_cutlass_builder`（8）、`ragged_ops`（8）、`transformer_inference`（6）等——#9085 之前它们各自抄了七份几乎相同的目标过滤与 GPU 检查代码，现在收敛成一个类属性加两个基类方法。

**（4）决策中枢与"泄漏"修复。** [compute_capability_args()](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/builder.py#L663-L767) 的完整逻辑分两支。JIT 分支解析目标的优先级写在 [L689-L705](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/builder.py#L689-L705)：暂存值 > 环境变量 > 探测可见 GPU；特别地，在"CUDA 已初始化的 fork 子进程"里探测会污染上下文，此时若无显式列表则直接抛出可操作的错误：

```python
if hasattr(torch.cuda, '_is_in_bad_fork') and torch.cuda._is_in_bad_fork():
    raise RuntimeError(
        f"DeepSpeed JIT builder for '{self.name}' cannot probe CUDA device capabilities "
        "in a forked subprocess ... Set TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST to specify target architectures explicitly.")
```

（配套的 `cuda_capability_major()`，[op_builder/builder.py:L645-L661](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/builder.py#L645-L661)，在 CUDA 上下文未初始化时干脆返回 `None` 跳过检查——保证 `import deepspeed` 不会偷偷初始化 CUDA、不破坏基于 fork 的多进程。）

两支公共的收尾逻辑：`filter_ccs()` 过滤（[L713-L716](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/builder.py#L713-L716)，过滤后为空则报错）→ 按 (major, minor, suffix) 去重（[L724-L728](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/builder.py#L724-L728)，与 PyTorch 自己的去重规则对齐，`8.0;8.0+PTX` 折叠成一条 sm_80 加一条 PTX）→ 没有任何 `+PTX` 时给**最高的无后缀架构**补上 PTX（[L731-L736](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/builder.py#L731-L736)；#9085 起预编译产物也享受这个兜底，以前只有 JIT 有）。

真正的"泄漏"修复体现在两个出口的不对称上。JIT 出口（[L745-L753](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/builder.py#L745-L753)）：

```python
if self.jit_mode:
    # Before torch 2.9, load() adds -gencode flags from TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST ... even
    # when extra_cuda_cflags already has some. So set the env var to the filtered arch list ...
    # jit_load() restores the caller's value.
    os.environ["TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST"] = ";".join(str(cc) for cc in ccs)
    return []
```

JIT 模式确实会写环境变量——但写的是**过滤后**的列表（防止 PyTorch 把 `filter_ccs()` 砍掉的架构加回来），而且外层的 [CUDAOpBuilder.jit_load()](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/builder.py#L841-L858) 在 `finally` 里**恢复调用方的原值**：

```python
def jit_load(self, verbose=True):
    torch_arch_list_present = "TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST" in os.environ
    torch_arch_list = os.environ.get("TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST")
    ...
    try:
        return super().jit_load(verbose)
    finally:
        if torch_arch_list_present:
            os.environ["TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST"] = torch_arch_list
        else:
            os.environ.pop("TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST", None)
```

预编译出口（[L755-L767](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/builder.py#L755-L767)）则**根本不碰环境变量**，直接返回显式 `-gencode`：

```python
# Non-JIT: return explicit flags per builder for extra_compile_args.
# BuildExtension uses these instead of TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST, so leave the env var alone: setup.py
# builds every op in one process, and each op must start from the requested arch list.
args = []
for cc in ccs:
    num = f"{cc.major}{cc.minor}{cc.suffix}"
    args.append(f'-gencode=arch=compute_{num},code=sm_{num}')
    if cc.ptx:
        args.append(f'-gencode=arch=compute_{num},code=compute_{num}')
return args
```

注释把原因说得很清楚：`setup.py` 在一个进程里构建所有算子，**每个算子都必须从"请求的完整列表"出发**。修复前的行为是：fp_quantizer 先把列表过滤成 `8.0;9.0` 再写回 `TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST`，后续算子（它们自己 `MIN_COMPUTE_CAPABILITY` 为 None 或更低）读到的是被削减过的列表——`7.0;7.5;8.0;9.0` 的请求最终让 10 个算子缺了 sm_70/sm_75。这个反差还有个讽刺的副产品：全量预编译本来会因默认列表里的 6.x/7.x 触发"BF16 一票否决"，恰好是这次泄漏砍掉了老架构才让 BF16 意外存活——两个 bug 互相掩盖。

对应的回归测试（本周期新增）在 [tests/unit/ops/test_op_builder.py:L231-L245](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/tests/unit/ops/test_op_builder.py#L231-L245)：

```python
def test_prebuilt_op_that_drops_archs_does_not_drop_them_for_the_ops_built_after_it():
    # setup.py pre-builds every op in one process. An op that drops the archs it cannot run on, as
    # fp_quantizer drops those below 8.0, must leave them in place for the ops built after it.
    def keep_ampere_and_newer(ccs):
        return [cc for cc in ccs if cc.major >= 8]

    with patch.dict(os.environ, {"TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST": "7.0;7.5;8.0;9.0"}, clear=False):
        make_builder(jit_mode=False, filter_ccs=keep_ampere_and_newer).compute_capability_args()
        next_op_args = make_builder(jit_mode=False).compute_capability_args()

    assert next_op_args == [
        "-gencode=arch=compute_70,code=sm_70",
        "-gencode=arch=compute_75,code=sm_75",
        ...
```

第二个 builder 拿到的仍包含 sm_70/sm_75——这正是修复后的契约。

**（5）BF16 规则。** [op_builder/builder.py:L738-L743](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/builder.py#L738-L743)：

```python
# Ampere (8.x) and newer GPUs have native bf16 arithmetic. For older targets, nvcc 12.2+ computes it in
# float instead, while older toolkits fail to compile the BF16 kernels for them.
self.enable_bf16 = all(cc.major >= 8 for cc in ccs)
if not self.enable_bf16:
    from torch.utils.cpp_extension import CUDA_HOME
    self.enable_bf16 = CUDA_HOME is not None and installed_cuda_version() >= (12, 2)
```

启用后在 [extra_compile_args()](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/builder.py#L860-L875) 里落到编译参数（cxx 与 nvcc 两边都加宏）：

```python
if self.enable_bf16:
    cxx_args.append("-DBF16_AVAILABLE")
    nvcc_args.append("-DBF16_AVAILABLE")
    nvcc_args.append("-U__CUDA_NO_BFLOAT16_OPERATORS__")
    nvcc_args.append("-U__CUDA_NO_BFLOAT162_OPERATORS__")
    nvcc_args.append("-U__CUDA_NO_BFLOAT16_CONVERSIONS__")
```

参数化的回归测试 [tests/unit/ops/test_op_builder.py:L178-L199](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/tests/unit/ops/test_op_builder.py#L178-L199) 把规则边界钉死：`7.0;8.0` + nvcc 12.1 → 不启用；`7.0;8.0` + nvcc 12.2 → 启用；`8.0;9.0` + nvcc 12.1 → 启用。

**（6）CUDA 版本检查的新规则。** [assert_no_cuda_mismatch()](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/builder.py#L185-L209) 拿 `installed_cuda_version()`（nvcc 的版本）与 `torch.version.cuda`（torch 编译时用的 CUDA 版本）比对：主版本不一致抛 `CUDAMismatchException`（`DS_SKIP_CUDA_CHECK=1` 可强行放行，[L198-L204](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/builder.py#L198-L204)）；次版本不一致只打警告（[L193-L197](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/builder.py#L193-L197)）——理由写在注释里：CUDA 保证同一大版本内向后兼容。手工维护的 `cuda_minor_mismatch_ok` 表被整体删除。这个检查现在由 `extra_compile_args()` 统一调用（[L860-L864](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/builder.py#L860-L864)），而预编译与 JIT 都经过它，所以 JIT 路径也首次被覆盖。

另有一个小但相关的清理：[cxx_args()](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/op_builder/builder.py#L905-L910) 不再传任何 `-std` 旗标——PyTorch 会为自己的头文件加上所需 C++ 标准（torch 2.12 前是 C++17，之后是 C++20），命令行上后出现的 `-std` 会把它覆盖掉。
